facts.fact: Search-result summaries (not pages I opened) put the 10-year yield at 4.92% on 2026-11-02, down 2 bp from the prior session.

The same summaries cite a Fed H.15 10-year value of 4.94 on 2026-10-30 and 4.98 on 2026-10-29.
The threshold of 4.94 therefore equals the 10-30 value and is about 2 bp above the 11-02 level.
The summaries describe the yield as near a seven-week low and say it had come down from a peak above 5.18%, the highest since 2002, reached around the September jobs report.
A CNBC headline dated 2026-09-04 says the 2-year yield rose to its highest since January 2025 after a hot jobs report raised expectations that the Fed could raise rates.
